decisions.finding: Beneath the stem of the Vav in יִוְקֶשׁ־בוֹ at x=2495..2511, high-resolution zoom 6 capture reveals two distinct, vertically aligned punch dots forming a Sheva: a top dot at y=268..281 (center x=2502.5, y=276) and a bottom dot at y=288..304 (center x=2503, y=297), separated by 6 rows of clean white paper (y=282..287) and followed by clean white paper below. Both dots reach minimum pixel brightness 0 (pure black ink). Distinct from a horizontal Patah bar or a single Hiriq dot; matches positive control Sheva on the same verse line. Confirmed printed Sheva (U+05B0).

Beneath the loop and stem of the Qof in יִוְקֶשׁ־בוֹ at x=2380..2415, high-resolution zoom 6 capture reveals an inverted equilateral triangle of three distinct punch dots forming a Segol: top-left dot at x=2380..2396, y=269..281 (center x=2388, y=275), top-right dot at x=2403..2415, y=268..284 (center x=2409, y=276), and bottom-center dot at x=2387..2404, y=288..304 (center x=2395.5, y=296). All dots reach minimum pixel brightness 0 (pure black ink), bordered by clean white paper. Matches positive control Segol on the same verse line. Confirmed printed Segol (U+05B6).
